text.text_excerpt: When I've been to the Audubon Tea Room, it has been as a guest at a wedding reception. It's a beautiful room, quite large, with polished wooden floors. The ceiling seems to stretch up forever with a fantastic chandelier dominating the center. The food has always been good. I understand it is their catering that serves it. Plenty of parking, even when there is an event at the zoo. The back of the room has several sets of double French doors leading out to the Tea Garden. I can't really comment on the gardens as the receptions have been at night. The bathrooms are always clean.

According to the Audubon Institute website, "Audubon Tea Room is the most prestigious of [their] venues, with gleaming wood floors, soaring ceilings, silk drapes and an impressive series of double doors leading to the lush Tea Room Garden. Beauty and elegance is always waiting to welcome you and your guests." Overall, this is a pretty accurate assessment of the space. (Which I guess is good, since it is the information they provide on their own website...) It's a large, circular room that's host to all kinds of events, but I've mostly been there for luncheons and weddings. This is a magical (if, I presume, insanely expensive) place to have weddings (though the imaginary weddings I've atte...

Audubon Tea Room was the venue for an event at my job this past Sunday. It was a formal awards ceremony and the venue was perfect for the occasion. I was particularly impressed with the giant chandelier in the middle of the room. The management staff and the servers were all delightful to work with, and when we sat down to enjoy the meal with the rest of the guests, the service we received was excellent.
